agents.name: zc-impact
agents.description: Coding-Mikro-Worker (Cluster: coder). Ermittelt vor jeder Änderung betroffene Dateien, APIs, Typen und Seiteneffekte — reine Impact-Analyse, schreibt nichts. Nutzen als erster Schritt von zc-coders Mikrophasen-Workflow.

agents.name: zc-patch
agents.description: Coding-Mikro-Worker (Cluster: coder). Implementiert exakt den freigegebenen minimalen Change-Set in kleinen, logisch isolierten Patches. Nutzen nach zc-changeset, vor zc-selftest.

agents.name: zc-repro
agents.description: Debug-Mikro-Worker (Cluster: debug). Reproduziert einen Fehler stabil oder dokumentiert saubere Nicht-Reproduzierbarkeit. Nutzen als erster Schritt von zc-debugs Hypothesen-Schwarm.

agents.name: zc-selftest
agents.description: Coding-Mikro-Worker (Cluster: coder). Führt nach einem Patch schnelle lokale Checks (Tests/Lint/Build) aus und meldet ehrlich, was fehlschlägt. Nutzen als letzter Schritt der Coding-Mikrophasen, vor Handoff an zc-verify oder zc-debug.

agents.name: zc-trace
agents.description: Debug-Mikro-Worker (Cluster: debug). Analysiert Logs, Stacktraces und Datenfluss, um wahrscheinliche Ursachenzonen einzugrenzen — ohne selbst eine Root-Cause zu behaupten. Nutzen nach zc-repro, vor zc-hypothesis.

agents.name: zc-verify
agents.description: ZCode-Team Verifikations-Agent. Führt 7 Pflicht-Checks (Syntax, Tests, Lint, Types, Diff-Review, Security-Schnellcheck, Regression) gegen den zc-coder/zc-debug-Output aus. Ändert selbst keine Logik. Nutzen als letzter Check vor zc-gate.

agents.name: zc-vision
agents.description: ZCode-Team multimodaler Analyse-Agent für Screenshots, UI-Mockups, Code-Diffs-als-Bild und Architektur-Diagramme. Nutzen, wenn ein visueller Befund (UI-Bug, Layout-Bruch, Diagramm-Abgleich) gebraucht wird, bevor zc-coder/zc-verify weiterarbeiten.

workflows.name: Multi-agent master (fan-out → synthesis)
workflows.when: A task with several independent facets that benefit from parallel specialist lenses converging into one synthesized result.

phases.exit_criteria: Task split into orthogonal sub-tasks, each with an owner lens and acceptance criteria.
phases.failure_modes: Overlapping sub-tasks that duplicate work or race on the same files.

phases.exit_criteria: Independent agents run concurrently, each blind to the others, returning structured findings.
phases.failure_modes: Shared mutable state across parallel workers; context bleed.

phases.exit_criteria: Findings deduped and merged into one coherent result.
phases.failure_modes: Concatenating outputs instead of reconciling them.

phases.exit_criteria: Independent PASS / RETRY / BLOCK on the synthesized result.
phases.failure_modes: Accepting the synthesis without an adversarial check.

workflows.name: Safe repo / folder cleanup
workflows.when: Tidying a directory, repo, or filesystem area — dedupe, archive, reorganize — without losing anything.

phases.exit_criteria: A dry-run inventory of candidates (dupes, cruft, stale files) with sizes exists.
phases.failure_modes: Deleting before scanning; trusting a stale doc over live state.

phases.exit_criteria: Each candidate labeled keep / archive / delete with a reason.
phases.failure_modes: Treating unfamiliar files as junk; touching another owner's runtime state.

phases.exit_criteria: A reversible backup (tar) of everything about to be removed exists.
phases.failure_modes: Skipping insurance on an irreversible action.

phases.exit_criteria: Only the approved set is removed/moved; user confirmed anything irreversible.
phases.failure_modes: rm -rf with a glob; removing symlink targets instead of the symlink.

phases.exit_criteria: Nothing unique lost; references updated; result matches the plan.
phases.failure_modes: Not re-checking that dependents still resolve.

workflows.name: Research to deliverable
workflows.when: Turning an open question into a sourced deliverable — research brief, industry report, paper, or deck.

phases.exit_criteria: The question, audience, and deliverable format are pinned down.
phases.failure_modes: Researching broadly with no target artifact in mind.

phases.exit_criteria: Sources collected with citations; claims traceable (arxiv, web, registries in the library).
phases.failure_modes: Unsourced assertions; single-angle search.

phases.exit_criteria: Findings organized into an outline with a defensible thesis.
phases.failure_modes: Summarizing without a point of view.

phases.exit_criteria: Deliverable produced in the chosen format (doc / paper / deck / report).
phases.failure_modes: Format mismatch to audience; padding over substance.

phases.exit_criteria: Citations check out; format valid; no fabricated sources.
phases.failure_modes: Shipping unverified quotes or broken structure.

workflows.name: Defensive security audit
workflows.when: Auditing or hardening a Linux host, Docker/container stack, or network — blue-team review against a baseline.

phases.exit_criteria: Assets, threat model, and the baseline to audit against are stated.
phases.failure_modes: Auditing everything at once with no priority.

phases.exit_criteria: Host findings ranked by severity with exact remediation commands.
phases.failure_modes: Applying changes before confirming they are safe on a live machine.

phases.exit_criteria: Docker daemon + image + runtime posture assessed (Docker Bench, escape checks).
phases.failure_modes: Ignoring 0.0.0.0-bound published ports and UFW rule state.

phases.exit_criteria: Traffic/monitoring gaps identified; detection rules proposed.
phases.failure_modes: Detection without a hypothesis of what you are hunting.

phases.exit_criteria: Secret/SBOM findings folded into one prioritized, read-only report.
phases.failure_modes: Reporting a low score from a tool run without sudo (false negative).

workflows.name: Superpower-10x development pipeline
workflows.when: Building, extending, or debugging software where quality matters — the default end-to-end coding workflow.

phases.exit_criteria: Intent, constraints, and a chosen approach are written down and user-approved.
phases.failure_modes: Jumping to code before the problem is understood; unstated assumptions.

phases.exit_criteria: A bite-sized, verifiable task list with file paths exists.
phases.failure_modes: Tasks too coarse to verify; missing spec references.

phases.exit_criteria: Each task lands red→green→refactor with a passing test.
phases.failure_modes: Code before test; batching unrelated changes.

phases.exit_criteria: Any failure is root-caused (not patched at the symptom) and re-verified.
phases.failure_modes: Guess-and-check fixes that mask the real cause.

phases.exit_criteria: Tests/lint/types pass; branch closed out cleanly; done is proven, not assumed.
phases.failure_modes: Declaring done without running the checks.

workflows.name: ZCode 6-lane subagent swarm
workflows.when: Large or cross-cutting implementation/debug work worth decomposing across a staged multi-agent swarm with an independent quality gate.

phases.exit_criteria: Context gathered, task decomposed into work packages with a plan.
phases.failure_modes: Planning without reading the affected code first.

phases.exit_criteria: Any UI/screenshot/diagram/code-diff-as-image finding is captured before coding.
phases.failure_modes: Skipping a visual check when the task is visual.

phases.exit_criteria: Minimal change-set implemented in isolated patches (zc-impact → zc-changeset → zc-patch → zc-selftest).
phases.failure_modes: Writing beyond the approved change-set; no self-test.

phases.exit_criteria: On NEEDS_DEBUG, root cause found via zc-repro → zc-trace → zc-hypothesis → zc-fixvalidate.
phases.failure_modes: Spawned as a guess rather than on a real failure signal.

phases.exit_criteria: Syntax, tests, lint, types, diff-review, security quick-check, regression all pass.
phases.failure_modes: Changing logic during verification.

phases.exit_criteria: Independent PASS / RETRY / BLOCK decision with scored justification.
phases.failure_modes: Gate acting as first reviewer instead of final arbiter.
